caption:
3 AI tricks for small business owners 🛍️

Less time typing, more time running your business. Copy these into any AI chat:

1️⃣ Bad review?
"A customer left this review: [paste review]. Write a calm, kind public reply."

2️⃣ New product?
"Write a 2-line description for [your product]. Warm, not salesy."

3️⃣ Same question every day?
"Customers keep asking about [topic]. Write a short FAQ answer: [the facts]."

Always read it before you post, so it sounds like you.

Comment TEAM and I'll send you 5 more prompts like this 📩
